parts.name: base

features.name: Base with four through mounting holes

parts.source: Manufactured base plate, 120 x 80 x 8 mm. Material, manufacturing process and mounting-fastener capacity remain unverified. Four clearance holes are reserved for machine mounting.

parts.name: Welded guide end support

features.name: Orient screw support bore along X
Blind guide sockets and screw support bore

parts.source: Manufactured support, reused twice. Bottom face contacts base at Z8. Intended welded attachment to base; weld beads omitted, compatible materials, weld procedure, distortion and strength unverified. Blind sockets trap guide shafts axially when both supports are attached. Inner faces are positive carriage travel stops.

parts.name: Ground guide shaft diameter 8 length 68
parts.source: Manufactured cut-to-length guide shaft, reused twice; diameter 8 x 68. Material, straightness, hardness, finish and sliding wear unverified. Nominal line fit in end sockets; shafts axially enclosed by socket bottoms.

parts.name: carriage

features.name: Integral machined fork and guide block
Integral screw nut bore along X
Guided fork with integral nut and axle bores

parts.source: Manufactured one-piece fork carriage with integral M8x1.25 nut intent. Thread represented by smooth nominal-diameter bore; helical engagement, backlash, self-locking and thread strength unverified. Two diameter 8.2 guide bores on 48 mm spacing provide antirotation; clearance and wear require process validation. Fork inner faces Y=+-18 leave room for 30 mm roller and two 3 mm spacers. End reliefs clear future screw thrust collars at travel limits.

parts.name: roller

features.name: Positive bearing seat shoulder at Y8
Negative bearing seat shoulder at Y minus 8
Shouldered roller with retainer mounting holes

parts.source: Manufactured cylindrical idler, diameter 40 and face width 30, local axis Y. Two diameter 22 x 7 bearing seats terminate at integral shoulders Y=+-8. Central diameter 14 relief clears the inner-ring sleeve. Two M3 tapped holes per end accept positive outer-ring retainer plates. Threads are represented by nominal smooth bores. Materials, fits, runout, balance and 100 N load capacity unverified. A centered 20 mm belt has 5 mm nominal face margin per side; tracking is unverified.

parts.name: Purchased 608 bearing envelope
parts.source: Purchased hardware sourced from catalog bearing_608: 608 deep groove ball bearing, 8 x 22 x 7 mm; source dsl/standards (ISO 15) + bd_warehouse SKT. Envelope only, one annular solid. Internal races, rolling contact, seals, rotation and ratings are not represented or verified.

parts.name: Manufactured bearing retaining plate

features.name: Inner race and spacer clearance tool

parts.source: Manufactured plate reused on both roller ends. Diameter 37 x 1 with diameter 16 central clearance, retained by two M3 screws on 32 mm spacing. Plate overlaps the bearing envelope at each outer end; contact restricted to the actual outer race requires verification against a manufacturer bearing drawing. No assumed bearing rating.

parts.name: M3 slotted retainer screw simplified
parts.source: Unsourced purchased-fastener specification, reused four times: M3 nominal shank, 6 mm under-head length, diameter 5 x 1.5 head with actual screwdriver slot. Smooth thread envelope, no helical engagement or strength evidence. Final supplier dimensions and loosening prevention must be verified.

parts.name: Manufactured outer inner-ring spacer
parts.source: Manufactured spacer reused twice, diameter 12, bore 8.1 and length 3. Bridges bearing outer face to fork inner face while clearing the rotating retaining plate. Actual inner-ring contact diameter, tolerance stack and preload require verification.

parts.name: Manufactured inner-ring distance sleeve
parts.source: Manufactured diameter 12 x 16 sleeve with bore 8.1 between the two bearing inner rings. Allows axle clamping load to bypass rolling elements in the intended real bearing stack. Actual inner-ring widths and endplay require tolerance verification.

parts.name: Manufactured headed 8 mm axle

features.name: Y oriented axle with nut extension

parts.source: Manufactured diameter 8 axle with integral square head at negative Y and M8 threaded end at positive Y. Head provides positive axial retention and wrench flats. Nominal shank extends Y=-24 to +29; head Y=-27 to -24. Threads are smooth envelopes. Material, bearing fit, bending fatigue and thread strength under the illustrative 100 N load are unverified.

parts.name: M8 square axle nut simplified
parts.source: Unsourced purchased-fastener specification: M8 square nut, 12 mm across flats and 5 mm thick. Positive end retention is represented by a nut body bearing against the fork, with smooth nominal thread bore. Thread interlock, torque, loosening resistance and supplier dimensions remain unverified.

parts.name: Manufactured M8 adjustment screw with integral thrust shoulder

features.name: X screw from minus 38 to plus 72
Screw and integral captive thrust shoulder

parts.source: Manufactured M8x1.25 adjustment screw, local X axis. Diameter 8 nominal envelope from X=-38 to +72; integral diameter 12 shoulder at X27..30 bears on right support inner face. Reused M8 nut at X38..43 provides opposing axial retention and jams against threaded handwheel hub. Thread helices omitted; journals use nominal diameter envelopes. Intended travel 30 mm requires 24 turns at 1.25 mm pitch, not experimentally verified or kinematically solved. Material, thread engagement, backlash, self-locking, thrust friction, lubrication, tolerances, retention and strength remain unverified. Insert screw from left before fixing left support; rotate through carriage thread, seat shoulder, fit nut and wheel from right.

parts.name: Manufactured threaded handwheel with extended hub

features.name: Grip disc local X21 to X29
Through threaded bore local X minus 1 to 30

parts.source: Manufactured diameter 28 x 8 handwheel with integral diameter 12 extended hub, threaded M8x1.25 through bore represented by smooth nominal diameter. Occurrence starts at X43; grip spans X64..72, beyond base edge X60 for finger access. Hub end bears against reused M8 square nut at X43; tighten the jam interface while setting screw endplay so the right support is not clamped rigidly. Nut has 12 mm wrench flats. Bidirectional torque transmission, jam torque, loosening resistance, human hand clearance and adjustment effort require verification. No material or load rating assumed.
